items.summary: When the System Manager is not implemented via software using OS and transport APIs, the System Manager must follow §6.2.1 GENERAL PROFILE bindings.
In that non-software/API implementation condition, the System Manager must implement interactions per §B.3 as literally cited; §B.3 is Generic Module in Appendix B, not System Manager (§B.2).
When System Manager is software using OS/transport APIs, the interaction infrastructure must conform to §6.2.1 GENERAL PROFILE bindings.
Under software/OS/transport implementation, the System Manager must implement interactions per literally cited §B.3, with same source-reference discrepancy.
In GENERAL PROFILE, SOSA modules must implement in-band system management interactions conforming to §6.2.1.
In GENERAL PROFILE, modules without otherwise-specified interactions must implement in-band management per generic-module OpenAPI §B.3.

holds.detail: The System Manager rules point to B.3 (generic module); the original Appendix B.2 is expressly labeled System Manager with System Manager-SysMan-API.json. Preserve literal source wording and do not silently resolve as B.2.
Neither original native OpenAPI file obtained/read; table-provided interaction names and apparent return types are not validated against actual endpoint paths, request bodies, error codes or schemas.

The notes say the interaction-to-function mapping is maintained in source material not included in printed tables, and self-reference their interaction tables rather than preceding function tables. Do not invent one-to-one mapping.
